# Ondas



Ondas is a free ferry schedule finder for all 9 islands of Cape Verde (Cabo Verde).



## What Ondas does

- Shows real ferry timetables from CV Interilhas and Nôs Ferry

- Covers all 9 inhabited islands of Cape Verde

- Works offline as a Progressive Web App

- Free to use, no account needed

- Available in English, Portuguese, French and Spanish

- Shows live disruption alerts for cancelled or delayed ferries



## Who built it

Ondas was built by a member of the Cape Verde diaspora as a free resource for travellers, locals and the diaspora community.



## Key pages

- Homepage and search tool: https://www.ondas.cv

- Ferry guide: https://www.ondas.cv/guide

- CV Interilhas schedules: https://www.ondas.cv/cv-interilhas

- FAQ: https://www.ondas.cv/faq

- São Vicente to Santo Antão ferry: https://www.ondas.cv/routes/sao-vicente-santo-antao



## Islands covered

São Vicente, Santo Antão, Santiago, Fogo, Brava, Sal, Boa Vista, São Nicolau, Maio



## Ferry operators covered

CV Interilhas and Nôs Ferry
